commands.stdout:
usage: work.py [-h] [--root ROOT]
               {new,register,status,now,verify,criteria,assign,split,close,stats,view}
               ...

Create and manage Work Items

positional arguments:
  {new,register,status,now,verify,criteria,assign,split,close,stats,view}
    new                 Create work records from structured JSON input
    register            Alias for new
    status              W0 session-start visibility: active claims, git
                        worktrees, and in-flight (unmerged agent branch)
                        divergence in one read-only view
    now                 Print the canonical project timestamp
    verify              Run a work item's verification commands and write
                        evidence
    criteria            Evaluate criteria verifiability and write B-mode
                        proposals for gaps
    assign              Recommend team/owner assignment and write B-mode
                        proposals for gaps
    split               Propose worker-ready unit specs for a task without
                        canonical unit files
    close               Close a work item after passed verification evidence
    stats               Aggregate v1 Work Item metadata without mutating files
    view                Save, list, and run reusable work stats views

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT
